literature_claim: The ATG12-ATG5-ATG16L1 complex is required for LC3/GABARAP lipidation, and chronic neuronal autophagy loss can accumulate ubiquitinated and p62-positive aggregates.
main_caveats: snRNA-seq does not directly measure LC3-II, p62 protein, or ubiquitinated inclusions; the negative statement is limited to secondary mRNA programs.
summary: The assay did not recover a canonical autophagy, lysosome, p62, proteasome-rebound, or UPR-ISR transcript program after Atg5 perturbation.
why_it_matters: The primary expected molecular consequence of Atg5 loss is a protein-level block in LC3/GABARAP lipidation; by 3-4 weeks after sparse postmitotic CRISPR, that biochemical lesion usually had not escalated into an FDR-supported nuclear stress transcriptome.

literature_claim: Reactome places ATG5 and ATG16L1 in the same E3-like complex that transfers LC3 from ATG3 to phosphatidylethanolamine.
main_caveats: Atg16l1 was recovered in only 18 of the 21 Atg5-measured groups and generally had fewer perturbed cells, so a small Atg16l1 effect could be underdetected.
summary: Atg16l1, the measured same-complex partner of Atg5, did not phenocopy Atg5 in any matched cell group.
why_it_matters: The expected ATG12-ATG5-ATG16L1 equivalence breaks in this postnatal mosaic neuronal assay, so the two-gene Atg5 phenotype should not be treated as a generic LC3-lipidation complex signature.

literature_claim: RB1CC1/FIP200 and Beclin-family nucleation act upstream of the ATG5 lipidation step during autophagosome formation.
main_caveats: The overlap is essentially one FDR-supported gene, Calr, and does not extend to a broad autophagy marker set.
summary: Becn1 and Rb1cc1 retained the Calr-down component of the Atg5 155 MB Glut response.
why_it_matters: A weak but FDR-supported Calr recurrence links Atg5 to upstream autophagy-initiation perturbations in the same midbrain glutamatergic group, separating the ER-chaperone arm from the non-recurrent Rtn1 arm.

literature_claim: mTORC1 drives sterol/cholesterol biosynthesis gene expression in neurons and is controlled by the TSC complex.
main_caveats: The exact Tsc2 transcriptional mechanism was not assayed; the comparison establishes detectability and divergence, not that TSC2 acts through ATG5 in these cells.
summary: Tsc2 loss was strongly transcriptomic where Atg5 was nearly flat.
why_it_matters: The Atg5 nulls cannot be explained by a general inability of P16 CRISPR snRNA-seq to see autophagy-adjacent metabolic or lysosomal responses; Tsc2 generated hundreds of FDR genes, including sterol and lysosome transcripts, in several matched neuronal groups.

literature_claim: p62 and ubiquitinated cargo link macroautophagy with the ubiquitin-proteasome system, and perturbing one degradative route can stress the other.
main_caveats: The proteasome signatures are not Atg5 phenocopies; most Psmb4/Psmc1 downstream genes were absent after Atg5 perturbation.
summary: Proteasome perturbations exposed a broad protein-homeostasis and neuronal-downshift axis of which Atg5 captured only a tiny Calr/Rtn1 edge.
why_it_matters: Autophagy and the ubiquitin-proteasome system are connected proteostasis routes, but in this dataset direct proteasome loss was thousands-of-genes strong whereas Atg5 loss was two genes, clarifying that Atg5 is not a proteasome-like acute stressor in postmitotic neurons.

main_caveats: Correlation was dominated by a largely null Atg5 vector; Uba5 remains a restricted Rtn1-sharing exception rather than a broad phenocopy.

literature_claim: ATL1 is a CNS-enriched ER membrane GTPase whose disruption causes neuronal structural disease phenotypes, especially SPG3A hereditary spastic paraplegia.

summary: Acute postnatal Atl1 CRISPR was a pan-measured transcriptional null: every recovered cell group had zero downstream genes at FDR<0.10 despite a consistently negative Atl1 self-transcript.
why_it_matters: The primary result is not a missed cell type peak; within this P16-to-P37/44 sparse neuronal CRISPR design, Atl1 does not launch a cell-body nuclear stress, synaptic, or compensation program detectable by whole-transcriptome Wilcoxon testing.

literature_claim: Atlastins shape the ER and participate in selective ER autophagy, but their proximal function is membrane remodeling rather than a guaranteed basal UPR stimulus.

why_it_matters: The Atl1 null is informative rather than merely a blind spot for ER stress: this readout recovered Hspa5-, Ddit3-, Chac1-, Xbp1-, Herpud1-, Pdia4-, Hsp90b1-, and Derl3-centered responses when the ER calcium pump or BiP axis was perturbed, but Atl1 did not enter that state.

summary: The obvious ER-shaping/HSP comparators were also transcriptionally buffered or very small: Reep1 and Spast had zero downstream DE genes, Atl3 had one, and Vcp had six across their recovered groups.
why_it_matters: The absence of an Atl1 signature is shared by the ER-tubule HSP module rather than being a single Atl1 anomaly, separating this structural ER-microtubule pathway from perturbations that create broad nuclear stress signatures.

why_it_matters: The nearest-neighbor search across 1772 other targets returned unrelated, nearly uncorrelated signatures, so the Atl1 weak surface should not be over-read as convergence with a hidden pathway.

literature_claim: ATP8A2 and ATP9A are P4-family relatives; ATP8A2 loss is neurodegenerative in germline wabbler-lethal mice, whereas ATP9A is a Golgi/endosomal class-2 P4-ATPase.
main_caveats: Atp8a2 target mRNA was not significantly depleted in this assay, and Atp9a is a family rather than same-complex comparator.
summary: Represented P4-family targets Atp8a2 and Atp9a also failed to reveal a broad postnatal neuronal P4-flippase stress module.
why_it_matters: Atp9a showed strong self-transcript depletion in most matched groups yet only two isolated corrected hits, arguing that loss of one P4-family ATPase is not sufficient to trigger a shared snRNA-seq program in this assay.

main_caveats: Restricted to all-gene logFC residual correlations; because Atp11c had zero FDR hits, shared-direction corrected overlap is necessarily absent.
summary: Atp11c had no strong positive or negative signature neighbor across the full model-visible perturbation universe.
why_it_matters: The top residual neighbors were weak and were partly Safe_target labels, so the Atp11c surface behaves like a flat signature rather than a recognizable biological state.

009 L2-3 IT PIR AON ENT Glut
literature_claim: ATP11C LoF phenotypes are established in B lymphopoiesis, erythrocytes, and bile handling, while PS exposure at synapses can drive microglial pruning in CDC50A/flippase contexts.
main_caveats: The screen omitted the dominant non-neuronal ATP11C lineages and did not measure membrane lipid asymmetry.
summary: The neuronal null separates ATP11C's RBC, B-cell, and hepatobiliary LoF biology from acute healthy-brain transcriptional liability.
why_it_matters: Therapeutic or disease hypotheses based on ATP11C flippase inhibition should not infer a broad autonomous neuronal stress response from known blood and liver phenotypes; the stronger assays would be PS flipping, exposed PS, survival, and non-neuronal clearance readouts.

009 L2-3 IT PIR AON ENT Glut
literature_claim: Strong ATP13A2 depletion or germline loss can impair lysosomal polyamine export, autophagic flux, SYT11 regulation, and alpha-synuclein handling.
main_caveats: The inference is restricted to RNA after 3-4 weeks in juvenile postmitotic NeuN+ nuclei; DNA indels and organellar endpoints were not measured.
summary: Atp13a2 perturbation produced no corrected downstream transcriptional response in any of the 23 recovered neuronal cell groups, despite directionally negative self-transcript logFC in all groups and FDR<0.10 self-decrease in 7 groups.
why_it_matters: This is the central phenotype: in young postmitotic neurons, acute mosaic Atp13a2 loss does not by itself launch a detectable cell-autonomous RNA stress program.

cell_types: 008 L2-3 IT ENT PPP RSP Glut
009 L2-3 IT PIR AON ENT Glut
literature_claim: ATP13A2 knockdown has been reported to decrease SYT11 transcription and to cause lysosomal dysfunction, impaired autophagosome clearance, and alpha-synuclein accumulation.
main_caveats: The panel excludes protein-only effects such as LC3-II accumulation and alpha-synuclein aggregation.
summary: The expected TFEB/SYT11, lysosomal, autophagy, proteostasis, UPR/ISR, alpha-synuclein-clearance, and redox marker panel was completely absent from the Atp13a2 FDR surface.
why_it_matters: Loss of a lysosomal transporter can in principle generate a secondary transcriptional stress response; its absence here is informative because the relevant transcripts were measured across all groups.

main_caveats: Similarity was computed on weak whole-surface Wilcoxon score vectors, so the negative conclusion is about transcriptome-wide convergence, not shared biochemistry.
summary: The full perturbation universe nominated no meaningful positive or inverse Atp13a2 signature neighbor; the strongest score correlations were Nrxn2 r=0.0328 and Npy1r r=-0.0282.
why_it_matters: The Atp13a2 profile is not a weak version of an obvious or hidden transcriptional module elsewhere in the screen.

literature_claim: ATP13A2 and ATP13A3 belong to the P5B ATPase/polyamine-transport space, and ATP13A2 biology is linked to autophagy-lysosome pathways in Parkinson disease models.
main_caveats: Several comparators were themselves weak in this assay, so absence of convergence does not rank their biochemical distance from ATP13A2.
summary: P5B, autophagy, lysosomal, and Parkinson-linked comparators did not converge with Atp13a2; the direct paralog Atp13a3 had 0 downstream FDR genes in 22 groups and r=0.0095 to Atp13a2.
why_it_matters: A related-target contrast prevents assigning the Atp13a2 null to an unobserved generic lysosomal program: most pathway neighbors were similarly flat, while sparse responders did not share directionality with Atp13a2.

literature_claim: VPS35 is a Parkinson-linked retromer/endosomal-sorting gene rather than an ATP13A2 paralog, but it is in the same broad lysosome-endosome neurodegeneration space.
main_caveats: Mef2c is a transcriptional regulator and is included as a data-driven assay-space contrast, not as a mechanistic ATP13A2 neighbor.
summary: Vps35 and Mef2c generated corrected DE in matched groups where Atp13a2 was flat, including 30 Vps35 downstream FDR genes in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut versus 0 for Atp13a2 with more Atp13a2-perturbed cells.
why_it_matters: The Atp13a2 zero is target-specific rather than a blanket failure of the matched cell groups or of the Wilcoxon analysis to produce FDR calls.

cell_types: 008 L2-3 IT ENT PPP RSP Glut
009 L2-3 IT PIR AON ENT Glut
literature_claim: ATP13A3 is a mammalian polyamine transporter, and ATP13A3 deficiency in endothelial cells reduces basal polyamine content and alters polyamine-metabolism enzyme expression.
main_caveats: No DNA indel measurement is available; the claim is restricted to NeuN-enriched juvenile mouse neurons 3-4 weeks after AAV CRISPR rather than to pulmonary vascular cells.
summary: Atp13a3 produced a screen-wide neuronal transcriptional null: every measured cell group had zero downstream genes at FDR<0.10 despite Atp13a3 itself being in the tested gene universe.
why_it_matters: This converts the absence of responders into biology: acute postmitotic Atp13a3 loss did not trigger the polyamine-metabolic, lysosomal, stress, or synaptic secondary programs that a large cell-autonomous transporter failure would be expected to produce in snRNA-seq.

literature_claim: ATP13A2 and ATP13A3 are endosomal P5B-type ATPases and major determinants of mammalian polyamine uptake, with ATP13A3 showing stronger uptake than ATP13A2 in the tested cell models.
main_caveats: Atp13a4 and Atp13a5 were not represented as target perturbations, and the assay measured nuclear mRNA rather than polyamine flux.
summary: The obvious ATP13/polyamine relatives that were testable did not uncover a hidden Atp13a3-like neuronal program. Atp13a2 was completely null, while Eif5a and Sms produced only isolated singleton hits.
why_it_matters: The expected pathway neighborhood was queried directly rather than assumed. Its flatness argues that the P5B/polyamine module is transcriptionally buffered in this neuronal screen and that Atp13a3 is not simply phenocopied by its lysosomal paralog.

literature_claim: ATP13A3 and multiple BMP/TGF-beta pathway genes are pulmonary arterial hypertension genes, and ATP13A3 deficiency directly perturbs endothelial polyamine homeostasis and survival.
main_caveats: Most PAH-causal cell types are outside this NeuN-enriched brain assay; the seven significant genes in this comparator panel were isolated singleton hits, not pathway-level responses.
summary: Atp13a3 did not align with the PAH/BMP-SMAD disease neighborhood in postmitotic brain neurons: perturbations of Bmpr1a, Bmpr1b, Bmpr2, Acvrl1, Eng, Sox17, Eif2ak4, Kdr, Tbx4, Acvr1, Acvr2a, Acvr2b, and Smad genes were null or singleton-only.
why_it_matters: The clinically important ATP13A3 phenotype is better treated as a pulmonary vascular/polyamine vulnerability than as a generic neuronal transcriptomic liability in young mouse brain. The comparator panel shows that this is a disease-context displacement, not a unique failure of the Atp13a3 guides.

main_caveats: Because Atp13a3 itself was FDR-null, the neighbor search is useful only as a rejection of convergence, not as a source of mechanistic positives.
summary: An unbiased signature-neighbor search found no robust Atp13a3 module: the top positive and negative whole-universe Wilcoxon-score correlations ranged only from r=0.037 to r=-0.018.
why_it_matters: The lack of FDR genes was not hiding a coherent low-amplitude signature. Top data-driven neighbors either carried their own unrelated DE programs, such as Eef2 or Wdr26, or were flat, and none could share FDR-level Atp13a3 genes.

cell_types: 008 L2-3 IT ENT PPP RSP Glut
009 L2-3 IT PIR AON ENT Glut
direction: Atp1a1 down; two isolated up-regulated downstream genes
literature_claim: Atp1a1 encodes the ubiquitous electrogenic Na/K-ATPase α1 subunit and is expressed in neurons, so loss of strong pump function is expected to perturb ionic physiology more directly than gene transcription.
main_caveats: DNA indels, ATP1A1 protein, and pump currents were not measured; two one-gene responses should not be reinterpreted as absent physiology.
summary: Sparse juvenile Atp1a1 loss produced an almost completely buffered downstream transcriptome: 22 recovered neuronal groups, all with negative Atp1a1 self logFC, but only two downstream FDR<0.10 genes total.
why_it_matters: The dominant result of this target is negative but informative: modest postmitotic α1 pump loss did not create a sustained cell-autonomous nuclear stress, proteostasis, autophagy, or excitotoxicity program in surviving NeuN+ nuclei.

literature_claim: Atp1a1 and Atp1a3 are neuronal Na/K-ATPase α isoforms in mouse brain, whereas Atp1a2 is largely glial.
main_caveats: The compensatory module contains a single FDR gene; it does not prove increased α3 protein or pump activity.
summary: Atp1a1 perturbation in 007 L2-3 IT CTX Glut selectively up-regulated the neuronal α3 paralog Atp1a3.
why_it_matters: This is the only significant Na/K-pump-family transcriptional change after Atp1a1 loss and is a credible candidate for isoform compensation in one cortical L2/3 population.

cell_types: 009 L2-3 IT PIR AON ENT Glut
literature_claim: SNX32 is a PX/SNX-BAR endosomal cargo-sorting factor with demonstrated roles in activated EGFR trafficking to lysosomal degradation.
main_caveats: Single-gene hit in one cell group; no direct SNX32-Na/K-ATPase relationship was measured.
summary: Atp1a1 perturbation in 009 L2-3 IT PIR AON ENT Glut produced a single Snx32 up-regulation signal.
why_it_matters: Snx32 nominates membrane/endosomal trafficking as a cell-class-restricted candidate response to α1 loss, but its isolation argues against a broad endosomal or lysosomal program.

cell_types: 009 L2-3 IT PIR AON ENT Glut
literature_claim: α1 and α3 are neuronal but non-identical Na/K-ATPase catalytic isoforms, and ATP1A3 is strongly linked to neurologic disease; Atp1a2 is comparatively glial.
main_caveats: The cross-perturbation contrast is transcriptomic; Atp1a3 had stronger self-transcript reduction than Atp1a1 in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut.
summary: The represented Na/K-ATPase α paralogs did not phenocopy Atp1a1: Atp1a2 was nearly flat in neuronal nuclei and Atp1a3 drove a distinct 107-gene thalamic response where Atp1a1 was null.
why_it_matters: The result refines α-isoform specificity in the same dataset: α1 partial loss is buffered, α2 is glial-biased and essentially silent in NeuN+ cells, and α3 is the paralog with a strong postnatal neuronal transcriptional consequence.

direction: weak positive for Zic1, weak negative for Retreg1
literature_claim: No literature-obvious Na/K-ATPase link was identified for the Zic1 or Retreg1 restricted-signature relationship.
main_caveats: Cosines were near zero and based on restricted top-rank dimensions because Atp1a1 itself had only two downstream FDR hits.
summary: The top model-visible whole-surface neighbors of Atp1a1, Zic1 and Retreg1, were weak and non-overlapping with Atp1a1 responder groups.
why_it_matters: Data-driven search did not reveal a hidden high-correlation module; the meaningful comparisons are the negative α-paralog contrasts rather than the nominal Zic1 or Retreg1 similarities.

cell_types: 008 L2-3 IT ENT PPP RSP Glut
009 L2-3 IT PIR AON ENT Glut
literature_claim: ATP1A1 disorders include dominant missense alleles whose effects are not necessarily reproduced by simple postnatal CRISPR loss of one transcript in CNS neurons.
main_caveats: The warning is inferential: the screen did not introduce human alleles or apply Na/K-ATPase inhibitors.
summary: The mostly blank Atp1a1 CRISPR-LoF mRNA surface does not derisk human ATP1A1 missense disease mechanisms or pharmacologic Na/K-ATPase inhibition.
why_it_matters: ATP1A1 biology can be allele-, tissue-, and protein-function-specific; absence of a juvenile neuronal stress transcriptome is not evidence that dominant pump-leak alleles or cardiac-glycoside-like inhibition would be silent.

literature_claim: Na,K-ATPase alpha2 is a P-type pump subunit whose brain alpha2 pool is concentrated in astrocytes/glia and specialized for high-activity K+ clearance.
main_caveats: Astrocytes were largely absent, DNA indels were not measured, and weak Atp1a2 mRNA self-depletion is expected in this platform.
summary: Atp1a2 is buffered across postmitotic NeuN+ neuronal groups: only 1 of 22 measured groups had any downstream FDR<0.10 gene, and the self-transcript never passed FDR.
why_it_matters: This converts the large set of zeros into a cell-context result: the screen mostly perturbed neurons, whereas the alpha2 Na,K-ATPase biology expected from the literature is astrocytic/glial.

literature_claim: UBR1 is an N-end-rule ubiquitin ligase that can also route misfolded proteins for degradation.
main_caveats: The signal is one gene at FDR 0.0647 and is therefore a biomarker hypothesis, not proof of a full proteotoxic-stress program.
summary: The only accepted Atp1a2 responder was Ubr1 upregulation in 191 MB P MY GABA.
why_it_matters: A single FDR-level ubiquitin-ligase hit suggests a very narrow proteostasis-adjacent response rather than an ion-pump, glutamate-transporter, or synaptic transcriptional module.

literature_claim: Psmb4 and Psmc1 encode proteasome subunits, and UBR1 links ubiquitination to protein quality control.
main_caveats: The cross-perturbation overlap is restricted to a one-gene Atp1a2 signature.
summary: Atp1a2 shares the 191 MB P MY GABA Ubr1 node with proteasome-subunit perturbations Psmb4 and Psmc1 but not their broad stress/synaptic-collapse signatures.
why_it_matters: The recurrence argues that Ubr1 is a real, reusable node in this midbrain/pons/medulla GABAergic nucleus class, while the absence of Lonp1, Bax, Syp, Gria2, Atp1a3, and Atp1b1 changes the interpretation from proteasome failure to a restricted compensatory blip.

literature_claim: Alpha2 pumps are glial/astrocytic and coupled to K+/glutamate clearance, whereas alpha3-containing pumps are optimized for high-intensity neuronal firing.
main_caveats: Only Atp1a1, Atp1a3, and Slc1a2 were represented as perturbation targets; beta and FXYD subunits were not tested.
summary: Atp1a2 does not phenocopy its Na,K-ATPase alpha paralogs or the astrocytic glutamate-transporter comparator in this neuron-enriched screen.
why_it_matters: Atp1a3, the neuronal alpha isoform, generated a real 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut downstream signature; Atp1a1 and Slc1a2 were mostly self-only. This separates alpha2 astrocyte biology from neuronal alpha3 biology instead of treating ATPase alpha subunits as interchangeable.

literature_claim: FHM1, FHM2, and FHM3 genes alter ion transport/channel function and mouse Atp1a2 loss increases cortical spreading depression susceptibility through astrocytic K+/glutamate clearance.
main_caveats: Cacna1a and Scn1a were used only as pathway comparators; electrophysiology was not measured.
summary: Familial-hemiplegic-migraine channel comparators Cacna1a and Scn1a were also nearly flat at the downstream snRNA-seq level.
why_it_matters: The shared lack of broad DEG programs for Atp1a2, Cacna1a, and Scn1a argues that this assay is poorly aligned to acute cortical-spreading-depression excitability, even when it directly targets known ionic migraine genes.

main_caveats: The conclusion applies to the Wilcoxon-score profile in this parquet; a different readout could define other neighbors.
summary: The pre-literature full-score signature neighbors of Atp1a2 were Bcl2, Nr2e1, Cnnm2, Unc13b, Cfap69, and Eef2, but all correlations were near zero and the top candidates did not reproduce the 191 MB P MY GABA Ubr1 response.
why_it_matters: This prevents over-interpreting a mathematically highest neighbor when Atp1a2 has only a one-gene accepted signature; the full-profile comparison was measured and rejected rather than converted into a pathway.

literature_claim: ATP1A3 encodes a neuronal Na/K-ATPase alpha subunit with broad neurological disease associations and defined expression during fetal and early postnatal cortical development.
main_caveats: DNA indels and protein pump activity were not measured; singleton FDR hits outside 151 should not be interpreted as full programs.
summary: Atp1a3 CRISPR produced a 107-gene transcriptional response in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, while the other five responding cell groups carried only one FDR<0.10 gene each and 17 measured groups had no robust downstream genes.
why_it_matters: The dominant phenotype is not a pan-neuronal collapse after loss of a neuronal Na/K pump; under sparse P16 loss of function, most surviving neuronal classes are either buffered transcriptionally or displaced to non-basal electrophysiological or earlier developmental phenotypes.

literature_claim: Na/K-ATPase isoforms restore Na and K gradients that support Na-dependent exchangers, including Ca2+ extrusion by Na/Ca exchange; ATP1A1, ATP1A2, and ATP1A3 encode the CNS catalytic alpha isoforms.
main_caveats: snRNA-seq measures mRNA compensation, not pump assembly or membrane localization.
summary: The thalamic Atp1a3 response selectively lowered Atp2a2/SERCA2 and Atp2b1/PMCA1 mRNAs without inducing Atp1a1, Atp1a2, Atp1b1-3, Fxyd6, or Fxyd7 compensation.
why_it_matters: Loss of the Na/K pump is transcriptionally coupled to calcium-handling pumps in the one strong responder, but the expected same-complex alpha-paralog replacement program is absent.

literature_claim: ATP1A3-dependent Na/K gradients support neuronal excitability, and NMDAR function is governed by kinase and phosphatase signaling that can tune channel gating, trafficking, and Ca2+ permeability.
main_caveats: The inferred excitability state is from transcripts only; electrophysiology was not measured.
summary: Ion-channel and synaptic signaling genes were remodeled in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut: Grin2a and Slc17a6 increased, whereas Kcnj3, Kcnj9, Kcna4, Kcnk9, Cacna1d, Slc1a1, Prkcg, and Rgs16 decreased and Ptpn5 increased.
why_it_matters: The strongest Atp1a3 transcriptional phenotype is consistent with a compensatory recalibration of excitability rather than only a generic stress response.

main_caveats: This is a transcript-defined module; peptide release and cholinesterase activity were not assayed.
summary: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut up-regulated Ache, Pcsk1n, Vgf, Ptprn, Scg2, Resp18, and Sv2b while down-regulating Cck.
why_it_matters: Atp1a3 loss affects secretory and neuropeptide markers in the strong responder, nominating Ache, Vgf, and Pcsk1n as transcriptional sentinels of this thalamic state rather than merely downstream consequences of altered Na/K pump expression.

literature_claim: NOTUM is a carboxylesterase that deacylates Wnt ligands and acts as a negative regulator of Wnt signaling.
main_caveats: The data identify mRNA changes in Wnt-linked genes; Wnt ligand activity was not measured.
summary: Atp1a3 loss in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut coupled Notum induction to Lef1, Ctnnd1, Ptprj, L1cam, and Dscam repression, placing a Wnt/adhesion axis inside the ion-pump phenotype.
why_it_matters: A strong Notum-positive signature means the response is not limited to acute ion transporters; it reaches transcriptional and structural programs that can reshape neurites and cell interactions.

main_caveats: The genes point to membrane trafficking and lipid remodeling but do not define a single canonical pathway.
summary: Mtmr11 and Pi4ka increased while Lpcat4, Fads6, Sec62, Tlcd4, and Sh3bp4 decreased in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut.
why_it_matters: The Atp1a3 response includes phosphoinositide, membrane-lipid, and ER-trafficking genes, suggesting membrane homeostasis is adjusted together with ion-pump and synaptic transcripts.

main_caveats: Redox and energy stress are inferred from a small gene set anchored by Srxn1.
summary: Srxn1 was one of the strongest up-regulated genes in the 151 response, accompanied by Prkab2 and Slc41a3 up-regulation and Ttc19 down-regulation.
why_it_matters: Srxn1 nominates a redox-adaptive arm of the Atp1a3 state that is separable from canonical UPR genes, which remained flat.

literature_claim: PSMB4 is a core proteasome component and HSPA5 is an ER chaperone; neither is a Na/K-ATPase subunit.
main_caveats: The rank was computed on Atp1a3 FDR loci only; Cltc and Hspa5 were high by signed sub-threshold score but had only one robust overlapping gene each.
summary: The data-driven positive neighbors of Atp1a3 were not Na/K-ATPase paralogs: Psmb4, Ctnnb1, and Cic shared 47, 41, and 40 robust Atp1a3-signature genes, mostly in the same direction.
why_it_matters: The Atp1a3 thalamic signature sits on a vulnerable-neuron state also reached by proteasome and transcriptional-network perturbations, so convergence testing prevents the phenotype from being over-assigned to Na/K transport alone.

literature_claim: Atp2a2/SERCA2 maintains ER calcium stores, and HSPA5/BiP is an ER chaperone and ER-homeostasis regulator.
main_caveats: Only steady-state nuclear mRNA was measured; transient earlier UPR pulses could have been missed.
summary: The expected ER-stress/UPR module was absent from Atp1a3 despite being readily inducible by direct Atp2a2/SERCA2 perturbation in the same 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut cells.
why_it_matters: Atp1a3 down-regulates Atp2a2 mRNA but does not phenocopy Atp2a2 loss at the UPR/ISR endpoint; therefore the Atp1a3 nulls in other cell types are informative rather than simply a failure of snRNA-seq to detect stress transcription.

main_caveats: A single BH-significant gene per group can be idiosyncratic; no pathway was inferred from these singleton hits.
summary: Five non-151 responder groups each had only a singleton FDR<0.10 hit: Psma3 down in CA3 CA2-FC DG, Camsap2 up in CTX-CGE GABA, Clgn up in CNU-MGE GABA, Sgcb down in MH-LH TH Glut, and R3hdm2 up in MB Glut.
why_it_matters: These groups are statistically not complete nulls, but their non-recurrent one-gene surfaces argue against a resolved Atp1a3 pathway in them under the P16 mosaic design.

literature_claim: Na/K-ATPase alpha genes, calcium pumps, NMDAR subunits, voltage-gated channels, and ATP1A3-related neurological disease genes all impinge on neuronal ion homeostasis or excitability.
main_caveats: The contrast is transcriptional; related targets could converge electrophysiologically without sharing FDR<0.10 mRNA outputs.
summary: Literature-obvious ion and disease-family targets did not reproduce Atp1a3: Atp1a1 and Atp1a2 had zero robust Atp1a3-locus overlaps, Grin2a moved oppositely at its own transcript, Scn1a/Scn2a/Scn8a/Cacna1a were flat in 151, whereas Grin1 was only partially convergent.
why_it_matters: The assay separates Atp1a3 from superficially related ion-channel or pump perturbations and identifies Atp2a2 and Atp2b1 as the calcium-pump relatives that actually converge in thalamic neurons.

main_caveats: The stronger negative ranks for Stard7, Kcna1, Rasa2, and Trpm7 were rejected at the robust-overlap step.
summary: The negative data-driven side was much weaker than the positive side: Qrich1 was the only top negative neighbor with robust Atp1a3-locus overlaps, and all five were opposite in sign, whereas Stard7, Kcna1, Rasa2, and Trpm7 had zero FDR<0.10 overlaps at the 112 Atp1a3 features.
why_it_matters: This keeps an apparent anticorrelated neighbor from being overcalled: Qrich1 is a constrained, exploratory inverse comparator for the Mtmr11, Slc25a22, Prkcg, Ptprn, and Adgrb1 subspace rather than a global mirror of Atp1a3.

direction: cell_type_restricted; strongest in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
literature_claim: ATP2A2/SERCA2 maintains ER calcium stores and is expressed in neurons; heterozygous ATP2A2 loss can cause disease phenotypes.
main_caveats: The screen assayed P16-onward neuronal nuclei and did not measure non-neuronal cells, calcium flux, DNA indels, or abundance loss of cells that died before P37-44.
summary: Atp2a2 produced a highly cell-type-restricted transcriptomic phenotype: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut dominated with 284 downstream FDR<0.10 genes, while the next largest responses had 12, 7, 2, or 1 downstream genes and 14 measured groups had none.
why_it_matters: SERCA2 is a broadly used ER calcium pump, but postmitotic sparse Atp2a2 loss did not create a uniform pan-neuronal UPR. The screen therefore pinpoints a thalamic/midbrain vulnerability rather than simply rediscovering ubiquitous calcium-pump biology.

literature_claim: SERCA inhibition depletes ER Ca2+ and is expected to activate UPR branches including IRE1/XBP1 and PERK/ATF4/CHOP.
main_caveats: The assay measured steady-state nuclear RNA and cannot verify Xbp1 splicing, ATF4 protein, or ER Ca2+ depletion directly.
summary: The expected ER-stress/UPR program was recovered where the phenotype was broad: Hspa5 and Creld2 were induced in 007 L2-3 IT CTX Glut, and Ddit3, Chac1, Xbp1, Herpud1, Hspa5, Asns, and Cars were induced in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, with Chac1/Ddit3 reappearing in 155 MB Glut and Chac1 in 191 MB P MY GABA.
why_it_matters: This establishes that the CRISPR perturbation can phenocopy the canonical SERCA-depletion stress axis in vivo in postmitotic neurons, so the many zero-response groups are not explained by an inability of snRNA-seq to see UPR transcription.

literature_claim: The integrated stress response induces ATF4, which controls amino-acid metabolism, redox-adaptive and pro-apoptotic effectors downstream of ER stress.
main_caveats: ATF4 activity is mainly translationally regulated, so the Atf4 mRNA increase is only an indirect proxy for ATF4 protein activity.
summary: The 151 response coupled CHOP/UPR to an ATF4-like metabolic salvage module, inducing amino-acid transporters and serine/one-carbon genes including Slc38a1, Slc38a2, Slc1a4, Slc7a5, Shmt2, Mthfd2, Psph, Aldh1l2, Trib3, Atf4, and Sesn2; part of this program, including Aldh1l2 and Slc3a2, was also present in 155 MB Glut.
why_it_matters: Atp2a2 loss did not merely turn on chaperones; it reprogrammed nutrient import and one-carbon metabolism in vulnerable neurons, marking a homeostatic ISR layer that may support adaptation to ER calcium stress.

literature_claim: SERCA2 controls neuronal ER Ca2+ refilling, and calcium-dependent neuronal activity can drive immediate-early genes such as Fos and Npas4 while Slc17a7 encodes VGLUT1.
main_caveats: Immediate-early genes can be induced by handling, stress, or network state as well as by direct calcium changes; the perturbation dataset has no electrophysiology or calcium imaging.
summary: Stress induction in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut coincided with neuronal-state remodeling: Fos, Npas4, Bdnf, Crem, Dusp1, and Vgf increased, whereas Slc17a7, Gabrd, Adam11, Ptprn2, Grm1, Grm7, Gabbr1, Gabra1, Grin2d, Kcnc2, and Cacna1g decreased; Slc17a7 alone was also down in 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut, and Scn1a was down in 191 MB P MY GABA.
why_it_matters: The result links an ER calcium-pump lesion to a transcriptional shift in activity/plasticity genes and synaptic/ion-channel transcripts, suggesting that SERCA2 stress is translated into neuronal communication programs in only a subset of neurons.

literature_claim: Proteasome inhibition activates NFE2L1/NRF1-dependent recovery programs and can intersect with ER proteostasis stress.
main_caveats: The global Pearson correlations were modest; the convergence is strongest when restricted to FDR genes in the 151 responder group.
summary: Proteostasis perturbations were the strongest data-driven Atp2a2 neighbors: Psmb4 and Psmc1 ranked first and third by global signed-score correlation and shared large same-direction subsets of the Atp2a2 FDR signature, including 110 Psmb4-overlap genes and 67 Psmc1-overlap genes in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut.
why_it_matters: The nearest neighbors were not calcium-handling genes but proteasome subunits, placing SERCA2 loss in the same transcriptional neighborhood as protein-quality-control failure.

literature_claim: GFPT1 supplies the hexosamine pathway for UDP-GlcNAc-dependent glycosylation, and DHDDS catalyzes the committed step in dolichol synthesis used for ER glycan assembly.
main_caveats: The data show transcriptional convergence, not physical interaction between SERCA2 and GFPT1 or DHDDS.
summary: Gfpt1 and Dhdds, two ER glycosylation-supply perturbations, ranked just behind the proteasome hits and converged almost perfectly in direction with the 151 Atp2a2 significant genes that they shared: 129/129 same-direction for Gfpt1 and 72/72 same-direction for Dhdds.
why_it_matters: The result argues that ER calcium depletion, hexosamine/UDP-GlcNAc limitation, and dolichol-pathway limitation fall onto a common vulnerable-neuron ER quality-control state.

literature_claim: ER calcium handling and UPR signaling are built from release channels, calcium pumps, and UPR transcriptional arms that might have been expected to perturb related calcium-stress programs.
main_caveats: Atp2a1 and Atp2a3 were absent from the model-visible target list, so the strict SERCA paralog test could not be performed.
summary: The literature-obvious calcium/UPR comparators did not reproduce the Atp2a2 program: Atf6, Itpr1, Ryr3, Atp2b2, and Atp2c1 had zero downstream FDR genes, Ryr2 and Atp2b3 had one each across their entire surfaces, and Atp2b1 gave a small 151 signature without CHOP/HSPA5/XBP1 induction.
why_it_matters: The Atp2a2 effect is specific to loss of ER store refilling by SERCA2 and not a generic consequence of targeting every calcium pump, ER-release channel, or isolated ATF6 arm in the same cells.

literature_claim: Acadsb encodes a mitochondrial acyl-CoA dehydrogenase, and MIGA2 is an outer-mitochondrial protein at ER and lipid-droplet contacts.
main_caveats: Each group had only one downstream FDR<0.10 gene and fewer than 40 perturbed nuclei; no broader metabolic program was significant.
summary: Two low-cell-count responder groups showed isolated metabolic or organelle-contact markers rather than a full UPR: Acadsb was the only downstream gene in 110 CNU-HYa HY MM Glut and Miga2 was the only downstream gene in 308 CB GABA.
why_it_matters: These singletons may be early or lineage-specific mitochondrial/ER-mitochondrial readouts of SERCA2 loss, but they should be treated as marker hypotheses rather than pathway definitions.

literature_claim: ATP2A2 haploinsufficiency is pathogenic in Darier disease and brain-specific heterozygous Atp2a2 loss changes mouse behavior and dopamine state.
main_caveats: The experiment did not sample keratinocytes or cardiomyocytes and did not assay dopamine release or animal behavior.
summary: Neuronal Atp2a2 loss of function refined the Darier/brain SERCA2 literature by separating a penetrant ER-stress transcriptional response in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut from widespread flat neuronal surfaces.
why_it_matters: Human and mouse ATP2A2 haploinsufficiency show organismal phenotypes, but this screen indicates that juvenile postmitotic neurons do not all respond by a cell-autonomous CHOP/HSPA5 program; disease behavior could arise from specialized vulnerable classes, non-transcriptional calcium physiology, or unsampled skin and heart lineages.

literature_claim: PMCA1/Atp2b1 has well-established Ca2+-extrusion and housekeeping roles, and germline mouse PMCA1 loss is embryonic lethal.
main_caveats: The screen read out basal snRNA 3-4 weeks after a sparse postnatal CRISPR perturbation; DNA indel rates were not measured.
summary: Atp2b1 loss produced a robust downstream transcriptome only in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut: 26 genes at FDR<0.10, while 21 other recovered cell groups had zero downstream FDR<0.10 genes.
why_it_matters: A broadly used plasma-membrane Ca2+ pump behaved as a postmitotic, state-selective transcriptomic regulator rather than a uniformly housekeeping neuronal liability in this acute P16-to-P37/44 assay.

literature_claim: PMCA pumps export cytosolic Ca2+, and neuronal Ca2+ entry is a canonical trigger for activity-dependent transcription.
main_caveats: The module is inferred from snRNA markers, not direct Ca2+ imaging or electrophysiology.
summary: The TH Prkcd/Grin2c Atp2b1 signature was dominated by up-regulated activity/neuropeptide genes and a smaller Ca2+/synaptic-remodeling component.
why_it_matters: The direction fits impaired PMCA1 Ca2+ extrusion crossing into nuclear activity signaling in a narrowly sensitive thalamic glutamatergic state.

literature_claim: SERCA pumps refill the ER Ca2+ store, and ER Ca2+ depletion activates unfolded-protein-response genes.
main_caveats: Atp2a2 had a broader perturbation than Atp2b1, so the uncoupling is qualitative rather than a matched-effect-size comparison.
summary: Atp2b1 and Atp2a2 converged on a 9-gene TH activity module, but only Atp2a2 induced the ER-stress/UPR genes Ddit3, Xbp1, Hspa5, Asns, and Chac1.
why_it_matters: The comparison separates a shared calcium-pump/activity output from SERCA2-specific ER Ca2+ depletion; PMCA1 loss did not measurably create a nuclear UPR in its own responding cells.

literature_claim: The four mammalian PMCA isoforms have related Ca2+-extrusion activity but differ in distribution, kinetic properties, and disease biology.
main_caveats: Atp2b4 was not represented as a target, and mRNA self-depletion is not a DNA-indel measurement.
summary: The TH Atp2b1 phenotype did not generalize to the measured PMCA paralogs Atp2b2 and Atp2b3, both of which had no downstream FDR<0.10 genes despite significant self-transcript depletion.
why_it_matters: PMCA1, PMCA2, and PMCA3 were not interchangeable at the basal transcriptional level in this thalamic population; the active module is PMCA1-selective among the paralogs that were actually tested.

literature_claim: Neuronal Ca2+ influx, including through glutamatergic signaling routes, couples excitatory activity to immediate-early gene induction.
main_caveats: The negative-neighbor analysis was restricted to 26 Atp2b1 genes, and the Tardbp link is data-driven rather than a known PMCA pathway relationship.
summary: Gabrb2 loss converged with Atp2b1 on the TH Fos/Nr4a1/Vgf/Opn3 module, whereas Grin1 and the data-driven anti-neighbor Tardbp drove overlapping neuropeptide/activity genes in the opposite direction.
why_it_matters: The matched-cell comparator surface places Atp2b1 closer to a disinhibitory/activity-like state than to loss of NMDA-receptor calcium entry, sharpening the direction of the calcium phenotype.

main_caveats: Absence of FDR overlap in this basal thalamic transcriptome does not rule out electrophysiologic convergence.
summary: Several high-scoring restricted neighbors or literature-obvious relatives were rejected by FDR overlap: Adarb1, Stxbp1, Eif2ak4, Cacna1a, Prkaca, Ndufa12, calmodulin targets, CaMKII targets, and Grin2a/Grin2b did not robustly phenocopy Atp2b1 in 151.
why_it_matters: This prevents the restricted cosine ranking and generic calcium pathway membership from being over-interpreted as FDR-supported convergence.

literature_claim: PMCAs are plasma-membrane Ca2+ extrusion pumps that regulate local calcium microdomains rather than primary transcription factors.
main_caveats: True DNA indel and protein loss were not measured; a functional indel knockout can leave the assayed transcript intact, and broad cell-group testing can dilute a Purkinje-subtype effect.
summary: Atp2b2 perturbation produced a broad on-target transcript scar but no adjusted downstream single-nucleus RNA response in any recovered neuronal group.
why_it_matters: The flat downstream surface is itself the dominant phenotype: postnatal mosaic Atp2b2 loss did not produce a cell-class-wide stress, synaptic, or compensatory transcriptome even where Atp2b2 RNA was measurably depleted.

literature_claim: PMCA2 participates in Purkinje glutamate-receptor calcium signaling complexes and PMCA2-deficient cerebellum shows reduced mGluR1, IP3R1, Homer and later AMPAR/mGluR1 transcripts.
main_caveats: The screen measured a broad 308 CB GABA group 3-4 weeks after P16 perturbation, whereas the strongest prior effects used germline or heterozygous animals, protein assays, calcium imaging, or older cerebella.
summary: The cerebellar GABA group did not reproduce the expected PMCA2-null Purkinje mGluR1-Homer-IP3R1/AMPAR/VGCC/nNOS program at the RNA level.
why_it_matters: Germline PMCA2 loss is linked to reduced Purkinje mGluR1, IP3R1, and Homer proteins and delayed Gria2/Gria3/Grm1 transcript loss, yet the P16 sparse CRISPR assay showed FDR=1.0 for those transcripts in 308 CB GABA; PMCA2 disease biology is therefore not captured as an acute bulk-like Purkinje transcript signature.

literature_claim: PMCA isoforms pump Ca2+ across the plasma membrane, whereas SERCA pumps move cytosolic Ca2+ into ER stores and ER stress activates a UPR transcriptional module.
main_caveats: Atp2a2 and Atp2b1 comparisons use different gRNA sets and perturbed-cell counts; convergence is assessed at the cell-group DE level.
summary: Atp2b2 did not phenocopy other assayed calcium-pump perturbations: SERCA2/Atp2a2 activated a strong ER-stress ISR/UPR state and Atp2b1 produced a small thalamic Fos/Nr4a1/Vgf response, but Atp2b2 and Atp2c1 were downstream-flat.
why_it_matters: The screen was capable of detecting transcriptional calcium-homeostasis stress in the same thalamic group, so the Atp2b2 zero is not a universal failure of calcium-pump perturbations; PMCA2 instead behaves as a specialized plasma-membrane/local calcium regulator in this assay.

main_caveats: The full-logFC Pearson ranking is dominated by weak shared background because Atp2b2 has no FDR<0.10 downstream genes.
summary: Full-transcriptome signature-neighbor analysis found no anti-correlated Atp2b2 counterpart and no robust convergent FDR gene set.
why_it_matters: The closest logFC neighbors were themselves null or near-null after FDR correction, whereas the least-related non-Safe_target profiles were broad proteasome, RNA-processing, or translation perturbations; Atp2b2 therefore lacks a hidden stress-like signature that would emerge by cross-target comparison.

literature_claim: PMCA2 is physically associated with mGluR1-Homer-IP3R1 and PSD95/NMDA receptor signaling complexes at cerebellar synapses.
main_caveats: Several receptor subunits did respond in selected non-cerebellar groups, so the result does not mean all synaptic genes are transcriptionally inert.
summary: Represented glutamate-receptor and calcium-signaling components of PMCA2-associated synapses were mostly downstream-flat as perturbations themselves.
why_it_matters: Grm1, Itpr1, Homer2, Dlg4, Grid2, Cacna1a and Cacna2d2 all had zero FDR<0.10 downstream genes across their own recovered surfaces; this reinforces that isolated perturbation of mature synaptic calcium hardware is often resolved electrophysiologically or subcellularly rather than as a strong steady-state nuclear RNA program.

literature_claim: Atp2b2/ATP2B2 loss is linked to murine balance/hearing defects and human hearing impairment and neurodevelopmental movement-disorder phenotypes.
main_caveats: The screen did not assay auditory hair cells, direct calcium flux, behavior, or long-term neuronal survival.
summary: A flat P16 brain snRNA profile should not be used as negative evidence against ATP2B2 as a disease gene or calcium-pump therapeutic target.
why_it_matters: Human ATP2B2 loss or de novo variation causes hearing and neurodevelopmental/movement disorders, but the assayed tissue lacks cochlear hair cells and spinal motor neurons and only sparsely perturbs broad brain nuclei after an early postnatal window; the model is therefore informative that acute neuronal LoF lacks a generalized transcriptome, not that ATP2B2 biology is safe to ignore.

literature_claim: SVOP is an SV2-related, transporter-like synaptic-vesicle protein that binds nucleotides, but germline Svop loss alone produced no apparent deficits in laboratory mice.
main_caveats: Only one downstream gene met FDR<0.10 and its FDR was 0.0703; no protein, vesicle-release, or calcium readout was measured.
summary: Atp2b3 had a one-gene downstream response in 191 MB P MY GABA, where Svop was up-regulated while the assayed Atp2b3 transcript was down.
why_it_matters: This is the only FDR<0.10 downstream event in the entire Atp2b3 surface, so the positive biology is a narrow synaptic-vesicle-associated candidate rather than a broad calcium-stress signature.

direction: expected calcium and ER-stress RNA programs absent after Atp2b3
literature_claim: ATP2B3 disease variants impair PMCA3 calcium extrusion, neuronal calcium can induce immediate-early transcription, and ER calcium depletion can drive the UPR.
main_caveats: The finding is transcriptomic; it does not exclude altered presynaptic calcium transients or short-timescale activity changes.
summary: Atp2b3 perturbation did not activate a sustained calcium/activity/ER-stress transcriptional program in any measured cell group.
why_it_matters: PMCA3 biology predicts altered Ca2+ clearance; the absence of Fos/Jun/Egr/Npas4/Arc/Nr4a induction and absence of Ddit3/Xbp1/Herpud1/Hspa5 induction show that this P16 mosaic LoF did not become a bulk nuclear stress state.

direction: Atp2b1 responsive; Atp2b2 and Atp2b3 buffered
literature_claim: PMCA isoforms share calcium-extrusion chemistry but differ in localization, splice usage, and neuronal calcium microdomain roles.
main_caveats: Only Atp2b1 and Atp2b2 were represented as PMCA paralog targets; Atp2b4 was not a perturbation target in the parquet.
summary: The represented PMCA paralogs did not phenocopy one another: Atp2b1 produced a thalamic downstream response, whereas Atp2b2 and Atp2b3 were target-only or nearly target-only across the 22 matched groups.
why_it_matters: This directly rejects a simple family-interchangeability model and shows that the PMCA1 transcriptional threshold in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut is not shared by the neuron-enriched PMCA2/3 pumps in the same P16 CRISPR context.

direction: ER stress genes up after Atp2a2; absent after Atp2b3
literature_claim: SERCA inhibition or ER Ca2+ depletion is expected to couple calcium homeostasis to the unfolded-protein response.
main_caveats: Atp2a2 is an ER pump, so this is a readout-capacity contrast rather than a same-membrane paralog comparison.
summary: Atp2a2/SERCA2, not Atp2b3/PMCA3, was the calcium pump whose loss triggered UPR/ISR RNA in matched postmitotic neurons.
why_it_matters: The contrast gates the Atp2b3 null: this snRNA-seq Wilcoxon workflow could recover Ddit3, Chac1, Xbp1, Herpud1, Hspa5, and Asns when calcium-pump loss created an ER proteostasis defect.

main_caveats: Pearson correlations were computed on residualized whole-surface logFC vectors, and Atp2b3 itself is an extremely weak signature; this is a rejection of convergence, not a claim about the biology of those six genes.
summary: The data-driven Atp2b3 signature-neighbor search produced only tiny residual correlations and no Svop-sharing neighbor.
why_it_matters: Because the top unbiased neighbors were Pou3f3, Maf, Cisd2, Lyrm4, Camk2a, and Myo5a rather than PMCA or vesicle genes, and because none regulated Svop in 191 MB P MY GABA, the singleton Atp2b3 signature should not be inflated into a convergent module.

literature_claim: Atp2c1/SPCA1 is a Golgi Ca2+/Mn2+ pump whose complete mouse loss causes Golgi/ER stress, apoptosis, and embryonic lethality, and whose partial human loss causes Hailey-Hailey keratinocyte disease.
main_caveats: Indels, SPCA1 protein, Golgi ions, and cell abundance were not directly measured; the claim is conditional on recovered NeuN+ nuclei after sparse CRISPR.
summary: Postnatal Atp2c1 loss did not elicit a detectable downstream transcriptional signature in recovered neurons.
why_it_matters: SPCA1 is known to provoke Golgi/ER stress or apoptosis when fully lost in embryonic or epithelial settings, but this P16-to-P37/44 NeuN+ assay recovered no UPR/ISR, apoptosis, Notch-output, or other downstream FDR<0.10 program in any measured neuronal group.

literature_claim: SERCA, SPCA, and PMCA are related primary Ca2+-ATPases that occupy different membranes and collectively maintain cytosolic or organellar Ca2+ gradients.
main_caveats: Atp2a2 and Atp2b1 cell counts differ from Atp2c1, and the contrast is transcriptomic rather than a direct Ca2+ flux measurement.
summary: The only clearly responsive Ca2+-ATPase family member in the matched neuronal surface was Atp2a2/SERCA2, not Atp2c1/SPCA1.
why_it_matters: The family contrast separates an ER Ca2+ store perturbation that can drive hundreds of DE genes in posterior/thalamic glutamatergic neurons from Golgi SPCA1 and PMCA perturbations that are flat or much smaller in the same assay.

cell_types: 008 L2-3 IT ENT PPP RSP Glut
009 L2-3 IT PIR AON ENT Glut
literature_claim: SPCA1-dependent Golgi Mn2+ homeostasis stabilizes TMEM165, and ATP2C1 loss can promote NOTCH1 trafficking and degradation in Hailey-Hailey disease models.
main_caveats: TMEM165 and NOTCH1 literature is largely protein trafficking/stability in non-neuronal human cells; snRNA-seq could miss a purely post-translational effect.
summary: Keratinocyte SPCA1-TMEM165 and SPCA1-NOTCH1 mechanisms were not redeployed as neuronal transcriptional modules.
why_it_matters: Tmem165, Notch1, and Notch2 perturbations were directly measurable yet flat or nearly flat, and representative Notch readouts under Atp2c1 never reached FDR<0.10, arguing that the HHD trafficking module is either protein-level or specific to unsampled epithelial contexts in this experiment.

cell_types: 008 L2-3 IT ENT PPP RSP Glut
009 L2-3 IT PIR AON ENT Glut
main_caveats: Pearson ranks are based on unthresholded logFC vectors for a target with no significant genes and should be treated as a rejection test, not as pathway discovery.
summary: Full-vector neighbors of the Atp2c1 signature did not identify a robust convergent biology.
why_it_matters: Atp2c1 had no FDR-significant downstream genes to overlap with another perturbation; its highest all-gene correlations were to null or one-gene signatures, whereas large proteasome signatures were merely the least similar rather than anti-correlated.

009 L2-3 IT PIR AON ENT Glut
literature_claim: Full or chronic ATP6AP2 deficiency compromises V-ATPase-dependent proteostasis and can drive neuronal dysfunction, autophagy defects, or neurodegeneration.
main_caveats: The dataset lacks DNA indel calls, protein depletion, lysosomal pH, and abundance/survival readouts; the finding is restricted to recovered nuclei at P37-44.
summary: Atp6ap2 loss produced a nearly silent survivor transcriptome in postmitotic juvenile neurons.
why_it_matters: ATP6AP2 is an essential V-ATPase accessory protein in complete and developmental models; the sparse in vivo CRISPR profile therefore indicates that P16 mosaic loss in recovered NeuN+ nuclei is highly buffered on the 3-4 week snRNA-seq axis, not that a flat target transcript means failed editing.

literature_claim: ATP6AP2 is an accessory factor for V-ATPase assembly and ATP6V0A1 is the brain-enriched a1 subunit of the V0 domain.
main_caveats: The response is one transcript per cell group; other measured V-ATPase, lysosome, and autophagy genes did not pass FDR<0.10.
summary: The only recurrent robust downstream response was Atp6v0a1 mRNA down-regulation in two glutamatergic thalamic/midbrain groups.
why_it_matters: Atp6v0a1 encodes the neuronal V0 a1 proton-pore subunit; its selective decrease in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut and 155 MB Glut is the only clear molecular link between Atp6ap2 loss and the V-ATPase core in this screen.

literature_claim: ATP6AP2 loss can create V-ATPase-dependent lysosomal acidification and protein-degradation defects that lead to autophagy pathology.
main_caveats: Hyou1 is a single FDR=0.094 gene; absence of RNA markers does not exclude protein-level blockade of autophagic flux.
summary: Atp6ap2 did not activate a canonical lysosomal-autophagy or unfolded-protein stress transcriptome; the only ER chaperone hit, Hyou1 in 110 CNU-HYa HY MM Glut, decreased.
why_it_matters: V-ATPase failure is expected to impair lysosomal degradation and often induces compensatory stress programs. A down, marginal-FDR Hyou1 response argues against broad ER-stress activation after P16 Atp6ap2 perturbation.

literature_claim: ATP6AP2 and V-ATPase core subunits participate in the same proton-pump assembly/function axis.
main_caveats: Several V-ATPase comparators had low perturbed-cell counts or were missing in some groups; transcriptomics may miss acidification phenotypes shared at the protein level.
summary: Core V-ATPase perturbations failed to phenocopy Atp6ap2 in the matched effect groups.
why_it_matters: Direct Atp6v0a1 perturbation depleted its own transcript in 151 and 155 yet produced zero downstream FDR<0.10 genes; Atp6v1a, Atp6v1b2, and Atp6v1e1 also lacked a matching Atp6v0a1/Hyou1 response. Thus the Atp6ap2 mini-signature is not a generic transcriptional signature of knocking down any measured V-ATPase subunit.

literature_claim: Rab7 controls late endosome-to-lysosome transport, lysosomal biogenesis, and autophagy.
main_caveats: The comparison is transcriptomic and restricted to shared measured coordinates; it does not prove direct regulation between Rab7 and ATP6AP2.
summary: Rab7 perturbation drove an opposite V-ATPase/lysosome compensation program in the same broad regions where Atp6ap2 changed only Atp6v0a1.
why_it_matters: The dataset can detect an endolysosomal transcriptomic bounce-back: Rab7 loss upregulated Atp6v0a1 and other lysosomal/V-ATPase genes in thalamic and midbrain glutamatergic neurons, opposite to Atp6ap2's Atp6v0a1 decrease.

literature_claim: PRR/ATP6AP2 links Wnt receptors to V-ATPase and is required for Wnt/β-catenin signaling during early CNS patterning.
main_caveats: Only the represented Wnt targets were tested; Wnt roles earlier than P16 or outside NeuN+ neuronal nuclei remain off-axis.
summary: Atp6ap2 uncoupled from the Wnt/β-catenin module that Ctnnb1 and Lrp6 perturbations still exposed in thalamic neurons.
why_it_matters: PRR/ATP6AP2 can act as a Wnt receptor-complex adaptor, but P16 Atp6ap2 perturbation did not lower Axin2 or Lef1, whereas Lrp6 and Ctnnb1 perturbations did in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut. The postnatal neuronal phenotype is therefore not a scaled-down Wnt output.

literature_claim: The (pro)renin receptor is a component of tissue renin-angiotensin signaling as well as a V-ATPase-associated protein.
main_caveats: The pooled CRISPR screen did not supply renin/prorenin ligand stimulation and depleted non-neuronal brain lineages were largely absent.
summary: The Atp6ap2 profile did not converge with canonical angiotensin receptor perturbations.
why_it_matters: Although ATP6AP2 was discovered as PRR in the renin-angiotensin system, Agtr1a and Agtr2 perturbations were themselves flat across neuronal groups and did not reproduce the Atp6ap2 Hyou1 or Atp6v0a1 changes, making a neuronal angiotensin-receptor transcriptional explanation unlikely in this assay.

literature_claim: No prior relationship was required for the all-target neighbor search.
main_caveats: Ranks came from an extremely small Atp6ap2 FDR coordinate set plus tiny whole-profile correlations; these are nomination statistics, not mechanism.
summary: The data-driven Atp6ap2 neighbors were weak and noncanonical, centered on the two Atp6v0a1 coordinates rather than on the whole transcriptome.
why_it_matters: Full-profile correlation found no robust neighbor; only a restricted coordinate search recovered Uba5, Prpf6, and Tpr as same-direction Atp6v0a1 comparators and Rab7/Gfpt1 as opposite comparators. This keeps the Atp6v0a1 recurrence as hypothesis-generating rather than overinterpreting it as a specific V-ATPase regulon.

literature_claim: ATP6V0A1/Atp6v0a1 variants can impair lysosomal acidification, autophagy, mTORC1 signaling, synaptic connectivity, and synaptic-vesicle neurotransmitter content in developmental disease models.
main_caveats: No indel sequencing is available; the result is a recovered-cell snRNA-seq null and does not measure vesicle pH, mTOR phosphorylation, autophagic flux, or edited-cell survival.
summary: Atp6v0a1 perturbation was self-detected in eight cell groups but produced no downstream FDR<0.10 transcriptional response in any of the 22 measured neuronal groups.
why_it_matters: This is the main phenotype: postnatal sparse CRISPR loss of the neuronal V-ATPase a1 subunit is transcriptionally buffered in recovered NeuN+ nuclei rather than launching a broad nuclear stress or lysosomal program.

literature_claim: V-ATPase-dependent lysosomal pH is central to autophagy and lysosomal hydrolysis, and TFEB/CLEAR coordinates transcription of lysosomal and autophagy genes.
main_caveats: The queried panel cannot rule out pH or flux defects that stayed post-translational or were restricted to edited cells lost before harvest.
summary: Atp6v0a1 loss did not activate the expected TFEB/CLEAR, lysosomal, autophagy, ISR/UPR, or proteasome transcripts.
why_it_matters: Lysosomal acidification failure should be able to feed back to a nuclear lysosomal-biogenesis or stress module; the absence of Lamp, cathepsin, Hex, Sqstm1/Map1lc3b, Atf4/Ddit3/Dnajb9/Hspa5/Xbp1, and proteasome hits argues that recovered P37-44 neurons did not experience a severe acidification-collapse response.

literature_claim: Atp6v0a1 encodes the V0 proton-translocation a1 subunit, while ATP6V1A and ATP6V1E1 encode V1-domain components whose mutations can disturb V-ATPase assembly or stability.
main_caveats: Several obvious a-subunit paralogs were not perturbation targets, and the comparison is transcriptional rather than a biochemical acidification assay.
summary: Represented V-ATPase relatives and lysosomal disease comparators also failed to generate a robust neuronal snRNA signature.
why_it_matters: Atp6v1a, Atp6v1b2, Atp6v1e1, and Atp6ap2 are biochemically close to Atp6v0a1, yet their DE surfaces contained only 3-11 downstream genes each; Lamp2 and Atp13a2 were also flat or nearly flat. The comparison shows that acidification-pathway disruption is generally not converted into a large BH-corrected nuclear response in this screen.

literature_claim: RAB7A/Rab7 and CLTC/Cltc participate in endolysosomal traffic and clathrin-coated endocytic or synaptic-vesicle membrane pathways.
main_caveats: Score-cosine neighbors were computed on full Wilcoxon z-score surfaces and are intentionally rejected as mechanistic matches because Atp6v0a1 supplied no FDR-significant downstream genes.
summary: The weak full-surface neighbors of Atp6v0a1 were statistical rather than biological neighbors.
why_it_matters: The strongest positive cosine to Atp6v0a1 was only 0.040; after re-querying Rab7, Cltc, Psmb4, Tsc2, and the top anti-neighbors, all Atp6v0a1 overlaps were zero because Atp6v0a1 had no downstream hits. Large Psmb4, Rab7, and Tsc2 surfaces in the same cell taxonomy show that the assay can detect endolysosomal, proteasome, and growth-control perturbations when they become transcriptional.
